title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips

claims.claim: Tenstorrent, 1.5 milyar dolar yatırım alarak değerlemesini 6.2 milyar dolara çıkardı.

evidence.quote: Tenstorrent, a chip startup focused on inference, has raised $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation.
The round comes five months after the 10-year-old Nvidia challenger reportedly received acquisition interest from Intel and Qualcomm at valuations of as much as $5 billion.
The round comes five months after the 10-year-old Nvidia challenger

claims.claim: Şirketin değerlemesi 2024 sonundaki 2.6 milyar dolardan iki katından fazla artmıştır.

evidence.quote: The fresh round, which more than doubled Tenstorrent’s valuation from the $2.6 billion it fetched in late 2024, was led by Trace Capital
The fresh round, which more than doubled Tenstorrent’s valuation from the $2.6 billion it fetched in late 2024

claims.claim: Yatırım turu Trace Capital ve Innovation X tarafından yönetilmiştir.

evidence.quote: The fresh round, which more than doubled Tenstorrent’s valuation from the $2.6 billion it fetched in late 2024, was led by Trace Capital, a new firm launched by Quiet Capital co-founder Ben Mahdavi, and Innovation X.

claims.claim: Yatırım turuna katılan diğer destekçiler arasında Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk ve T. Rowe Price yer almaktadır.

evidence.quote: Other backers included Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk, and T. Rowe Price.

claims.claim: Tenstorrent CEO'su Jim Keller, şirketin Galaxy sunucularının DeepSeek modellerini çalıştırabildiğini göstermesinin ardından bağımsız kalmaya ve sermaye artırmaya karar verdiğini belirtti.

evidence.quote: Jim Keller, a prominent microprocessor engineer and Tenstorrent CEO, told Bloomberg that the company decided to remain independent and raise more capital after it showed that its Galaxy servers could run DeepSeek models.
